question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(5, 18, 32)
solution:
The logic followed here is:

__
 
• **2nd number = (1st number × 4) - 2**
 
• **3rd number = (2ⁿd number × 2) - 4**

(5, 18, 32)

 
• 2nd number = 5 × 4 - 2 = 20 - 2 = 18 
 
• 3rd number = 18 × 2 - 4 = 36 - 4 = 32 

Similarly, 

**Option 4: (9, 34, 64)**

 
• **2nd number = 9 × 4 - 2 = 36 - 2 = 34**
 
• **3rd number = 34 × 2 - 4 = 68 - 4 = 64 **

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **Alternate Method__**

__**First method:**__

**(Middle number x 4) - (First number x 8) = third number**

(5, 18, 32) 

__
 
• (18 x 4) - (5 x 8) = 72 - 40 = 32

Similarly, 

**Option 4: (9, 34, 64)**

 
• **(34 x 4) - (9 x 8) = 136 - 72 = 64**

**Second method:**__

The logic followed here is;

**(First Number × 3) + (First Number - 2) = Second Number**

**(Second Number × 2) - 4 = Third Number**

In (5, 18, 32);

 
• (5 × 3) + (5 - 2) 
 
• = 15 + 3 = 18
 
• (18 × 2) - 4 
 
• = 36 - 4

= 32

Similarly;

In (9, 34, 64);

 
• (9 × 3) + (9 - 2)
 
• = 27 + 7 = 34
 
• (34 × 2) - 4
 
• = 68 - 4
 
• = 64

Hence, **"(9, 34, 64)"** is the correct answer.
